title: Infrastructure as code from the first resource
statement: Every cloud resource is created by Terraform from day one; nothing is created by hand, so environments are reproducible and four environments cost little more than one.
rationale: Seed practice drafted from earlier proposal work. Review and confirm.

title: Reference landing zone, adapted not bespoke
statement: Start from the Datatonic reference landing zone and adapt it; a bespoke landing zone or one imposed by the client's enterprise architecture is a scope change.

title: HA VPN first, interconnect in parallel
statement: Carry the first data flows over HA VPN; order dedicated interconnect in parallel and keep it off the critical path, with routing designed so the switch is a swap.

title: Google Cloud native managed services by default
statement: Build the data platform on Google Cloud native managed services only: BigQuery, Dataform, Composer and Looker, unless a client rule says otherwise.

title: The semantic layer is the only path to data
statement: Reports, embedded analytics and AI read governed definitions in the semantic layer, never raw tables, so every answer agrees with every report.

title: Retention tiered by access pattern
statement: Tier data retention into immediately queryable, hot and cold storage according to how it is actually used.

title: Port transform logic like for like
statement: Existing transformation logic is ported as it behaves today; redesign or correction during the port is a change.

title: One-way log forwarding; the SOC perimeter stays with the client
statement: Forward platform logs one way to the client's existing SIEM; monitoring, triage and response remain the client's.

title: Agents propose, people confirm
statement: Agents may draft and propose; nothing an agent produces becomes a fact, a decision or a price until a named person confirms it.

title: Contracts first for every interface
statement: Every interface has a versioned schema agreed before build; breaking changes ship as a new version alongside the old one.
rationale: Seed practice drafted from earlier proposal work. Review and confirm.

title: Move in waves with a rehearsed rollback
statement: Workloads move in small waves grouped by dependency; each wave has a rollback rehearsed before cutover.
rationale: Seed practice drafted from earlier proposal work. Review and confirm.

title: Evaluate against real cases before go-live
statement: Each agent is measured against a set of real, client-supplied cases with an agreed accuracy bar before it acts on anything.
rationale: Seed practice drafted from earlier proposal work. Review and confirm.
